title: Research and Application of Assembled Spontaneous Combustion Coal Gangue External Wall Panel
content: In view of the current situation that the stock of coal gangue is increasing year by year, especially the problem of resource utilization after spontaneous combustion of coal gangue with large accumulation thickness, Shanxi Yangquan spontaneous combustion coal gangue was selected as the research object. After crushing and screening, it was used as the coarse and fine aggregate of concrete, and the spontaneous combustion coal gangue concrete with a strength of 26.58 MPa was obtained. The mechanical properties of spontaneous combustion coal gangue concrete were measured, and the spontaneous combustion coal gangue plate with 20 mm thickness, which can meet the requirements of impermeability and impact resistance, can be cut and hung, was made. According to the characteristics of the building exterior wall, the wall segmentation method is proposed, and the wallboard unit suitable for construction and transportation is obtained, so as to realize the industrialization of processing and manufacturing. By combining the spontaneous combustion coal gangue board with the rock wool, the energy saving and sound insulation requirements of the building exterior wall board are satisfied. Combined with the requirements of assembly construction, the external wall hoisting and fixed integrated connection structure is provided. The practical application of the assembled spontaneous combustion coal gangue exterior wallboard in the demonstration project provides a new way for the resource utilization of spontaneous combustion coal gangue.
